answer: Proof of Stake establishes Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a prohibitive cost to spawn identities. The network monitors the signal of staked assets to validate nodes. If an attacker reaches the nadir of protocol trust by attempting a takeover, the resulting economic ripple effect slashes their collateral, ensuring that generating thousands of fraudulent agents becomes an exercise in total financial self-destruction rather than a viable path to network dominance.
